text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
I replied in #inc-vtg-hartford. The first report was at 10:42 AM. The guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard while both lanes showed a white screen, and kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM.

I made a mistake in that reply. I added a line about ticket SUP-5380 (an 08:12 update) that I took from the knowledge brain, not from the channel. Mateo, Odile and the other members may not be able to see that ticket. I told you in a DM. I can't edit or delete posts, so the 09:00 reply is still up. You'll need to delete it in Slack if you want it gone. The 10:42 timing and the guard details come from the channel and are unaffected.
